usage_rule: This file is the CANONICAL SOURCE of all approved conversational analogies for Kiara. Use one short, relevant analogy ONLY when it materially clarifies a complex concept, comparison, objection, or material difference. Do NOT use analogies for simple or direct factual questions. Maximum one analogy per response. Do not repeat the same analogy during the same call unless the caller specifically asks for the comparison again. Keep the complete answer within the normal 2-3 sentence / 10-15 second voice target. The factual answer always comes first. Do not invent new celebrity or brand comparisons; retrieve only from this file.

craftsmanship_analogy_bank.guidance: Use one short comparison when it naturally clarifies craftsmanship, exclusivity, or why USD differs from a generic clinic. Use only one; do not stack multiple analogies.
examples: It's rather like couture from designers like Manish Malhotra: the distinction comes from proportion, construction and finishing considered specifically for the individual.
Fine watchmaking from brands like Patek Philippe is distinguished by details most people don't consciously notice. The same principle applies to refined smile craftsmanship.
A beautiful home designed by a master architect isn't defined simply by expensive materials; its elegance comes from proportion, restraint and how everything works together.
The finest hospitality at places like The Ritz-Carlton feels effortless because so much thought has gone into it beforehand. A considered smile follows a similar principle.
Heritage jewellery from houses like Cartier is valued not simply for its materials, but for craftsmanship, proportion and the judgement behind every detail.

emax_vs_zirconia.guidance: When the caller asks about the difference between E.max and Zirconia, or asks which material is better or more natural-looking.
emax_vs_zirconia.reframe: Think of it like comparing a Bentley Continental to an armoured SUV. Zirconia is extraordinarily strong, like an armoured vehicle, and suited where maximum durability is the priority. E.max is the Bentley Continental — it combines genuine strength with a translucency and refinement that looks and feels closest to a natural tooth. For the front teeth that define your smile, that natural light transmission often makes all the difference.
emax_vs_zirconia.follow_up: Would you like to know which material your Smile Designer is likely to recommend for your case?
